summary: The 42nd Indian Antarctic Expedition focused on climate change studies in the Antarctic Peninsula region, with emphasis on ice shelf dynamics and ocean acidification monitoring.
The 13th Indian Arctic Expedition conducted atmospheric studies and permafrost research in the Svalbard archipelago, building on long-term climate monitoring efforts.
The 41st Indian Antarctic Expedition continued long-term monitoring of ice sheet mass balance and ocean circulation patterns in the Southern Ocean.
The 12th Indian Arctic Expedition focused on atmospheric aerosol studies and their impact on Arctic climate systems.
The 40th Indian Antarctic Expedition studied biological responses to changing sea ice conditions in the Antarctic Peninsula region.
The 11th Indian Arctic Expedition investigated permafrost thaw dynamics and their implications for global carbon cycling.
